column3: Close to the Hebrew; “stones of holiness” is rendered “The stones of the sanctuary.”
Close to the Hebrew; “jars of earthenware” is rendered “clay pots.”

NKJV renders “the iniquity … than the sin of Sodom” as “The punishment of the iniquity … than the punishment of the sin” (the Hebrew words can mean either), and “no hands were wrung over her” as “With no hand to help her”; the last phrase is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “her consecrated ones” is rendered “Her Nazirites,” and “their polishing” “their appearance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “their skin has shriveled on their bone” is rendered “Their skin clings to their bones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they flow away, pierced, from [lack of] the produce of the field” is rendered “these pine away, Stricken for lack of the fruits of the field.”
Close to the Hebrew; “have boiled” is rendered “Have cooked.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will not continue to sojourn” is rendered “They shall no longer dwell here.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “The people” as the subject of the last two lines.
Close to the Hebrew; “your iniquity is finished” is rendered “The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished.”
